description: This file defines the BatchAttributeStep class, a custom ProseMirror step implementation for batch updating node attributes within a document, including methods for applying updates, inverting changes, mapping positions, and serialization.

classes.name: BatchAttributeStep
classes.description: A custom ProseMirror Step subclass for batching multiple attribute updates on nodes within a document.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the batch attribute updates to a given document node, returning a new document with updated attributes.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Recursively updates the content of nodes based on the update map, adjusting attributes as specified.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Creates an inverse step that reverts the attribute updates based on the current document state.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the step's update positions through a given position mapping, returning a new step or null if no updates remain.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the step to a JSON object for storage or transmission.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object to reconstruct a BatchAttributeStep instance.
